provider_notes: Mock supports authored key-value fixtures and narrow add-workstation/rename prompts only. Natural-language technical specs and all broader follow-ups require an explicitly selected live provider. Review every change set before accepting. Ordinary edits and exports use no model calls.

prompts.prompt: Rename Inventory web application to Warehouse stock application
prompts.expected: One rename; preserve identifiers and placement.

prompts.prompt: Add a stock-movement API for the finance integration in Z1, but leave its external endpoint, protocol and initiator unresolved. Ask me the most important integration question.
prompts.expected: Label unresolved integration facts and ask focused clarification; do not fabricate the finance system.

prompts.prompt: Make Inventory database a pair of active-passive instances and keep its zone Z2.
prompts.expected: Explicit quantity 2 and active_passive metadata after review; no automatic claim about backups or recovery time.
